correctness.rationale: With the exact sequential opinion-then-action update and exclusions of self-action, z(t+1)=P(t)z(t) is row-stochastic, with every positive entry at least eta=min(phi,1-phi)/n. Each action row of P(t+1)P(t) receives >=eta^2 from every old opinion (through its own intermediate action) and from every old action (through action mixing). Thus if limiting joint diameter D_infty>0, all actions eventually stay a common delta>0 away from both extremes. An opinion interacting with any action thereafter moves permanently into the interior; hence persistent extreme opinions at m and M must be isolated. Their cross-action gaps satisfy [y_b-m]+[M-y_a]=(1+phi)(M-m)>2epsilon, contradicting 2epsilon>=(1+phi)D0. Therefore diameter tends zero. Once D<epsilon every potential confidence link is active and the fixed complete-neighborhood stochastic matrix is primitive, yielding exponential convergence. The two-agent stationary configuration x=(a,a+d), y=(a+(1-phi)d/2,a+(1+phi)d/2) proves sharpness strictly below the boundary. Independent Fraction-based enumeration verified two-step action positivity for all possible directed neighborhood masks and pairs of masks at n=2,3 (16 and 4096 pairs), and the stationary identity.
